summary: Surfaces patterns a person might not have named yet, and keeps help within reach. Local only.
the_four_rules: NEVER SYNCED. No bus, no emitSync, no fetch, no socket — the module has no transport at all, and a test greps the source to prove it. If a partner could learn the app had flagged something, the person it flagged is in more danger than before.

NEVER DIAGNOSES. It does not say "you are being abused" and it does not say "you are abusive". A test bans a vocabulary list from every pattern string, and asserts each one ends in a QUESTION rather than a conclusion.
RESOURCES ARE ALWAYS AVAILABLE, never triggered at someone. Settings, any time, whether or not anything was noticed.
DISMISSAL IS PERMANENT AND SILENT. One per pattern, forever. No escalate/remind/re-ask method exists, and a test asserts that.
never_does: reads message content — a classifier over private messages is surveillance with a kind face
writes to shared_ or outbox namespaces
hardcodes a phone number that will rot
raises anything when the counts cannot be read — it fails closed
thresholds: Set high on purpose. A test feeds a bad week (3 ruptures, 2 could-not-says) and asserts NOTHING fires. A false positive here is a real harm and it burns the credibility of the one time it matters.
invariants: health() reports synced:0, hasTransport:false, readsMessageContent:false, diagnoses:false
each pattern shows the count that produced it (§17.5)
at most one notice per session, never a list
a non-numeric count is ignored rather than coerced
found_by_test: Two patterns ended in soft conclusions rather than questions — "Some things are not wanted, and that is an answer too." The test caught both. Softening a conclusion is still making one.
